notes.note: Followed import status, explicit resume and the completed-receipt branch through actual CLI processes on generated homes. Baseline plain retry replaced the intervening manifest and credential at an uncertain target. The new refusal preserves both until explicit resume, after which only named values are replaced and an omitted credential stays intact. A lost success response left one durable receipt. Status and resume recovered it without writes, and a plain post-completion import created a distinct operation.
